title: Mistral AI releases weights for Mistral Large 4 model
excerpt: The one-trillion-parameter multimodal model is now available for open-weight deployment with improved coding and cybersecurity capabilities.
bodyHtml:
Mistral AI announced on October 29, 2026, the release of the weights for Mistral Large 4, a one-trillion-parameter multimodal model. The model, which was previously in public preview, is designed for coding and defensive cybersecurity tasks.

The updated model features three reasoning modes to manage performance and inference costs. According to Mistral AI, the model leads open-weight benchmarks in coding, including FrontierCode and Terminal-Bench. Mistral AI stated the model achieves an average refusal rate of 96.6% on malicious cyber requests, the highest it measures among open models.

Mistral AI is providing enterprise design partners with preview access to a specialized variant of the model optimized for penetration testing and vulnerability assessment. This access is subject to contractual safeguards and restricted to authorized systems. Mistral AI stated it sees potential for uplift to conduct real attacks and is modifying its guardrails accordingly.
topic: Le Chonk: Built for Coders, Trusted by Defenders.
